description: Search Rick and Morty characters by name with optional filters for status (alive/dead/unknown), species (Human/Alien/etc.), and gender. Returns up to 20 matching characters per page with status, species, origin, current location, and episode appearances.

name.description: Character name to search for (partial match, e.g., "rick", "beth")

page.description: Page number (1-based, default 1). API returns 20 per page.

name: search_characters
